items.t: Said President Trump is bringing American industry and manufacturing back home, including power-grid equipment.

items.t: Said DOE is accelerating President Trump's American nuclear renaissance.
items.q: The Energy Department is accelerating President Trump’s American nuclear renaissance and unlocking the full potential of our nation’s nuclear fleet

items.t: Said the Trump administration is committed to doing everything in its power to lower energy costs for Americans.
items.q: The Trump Administration is committed to doing everything in our power to lower energy costs for the American people

record.t: Announced a $237 million DOE funding opportunity to boost American manufacturing of electric grid components.
record.q: today announced a $237 million funding opportunity to boost American manufacturing and strengthen supply chains for critical electric grid components

record.t: Announced a $5 billion DOE loan to expand and modernize existing nuclear power plants.
record.q: EDF is delivering on President Trump and Secretary Wright’s commitment to unleash American nuclear power by financing projects that modernize and expand our nation’s existing nuclear plants

record.t: Designated helium as a critical material under the Energy Act of 2020.
record.q: Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has designated helium as a critical material under the Energy Act of 2020.

record.t: Authorized an exchange of up to 315,000 barrels of fuel oil from the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve.
record.q: announced a Request for Proposal for an exchange of up to 315,000 barrels of ultra-low sulfur distillate (fuel oil) from the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve (NEHHOR)

record.t: Issued an emergency order directing PJM Interconnection to make additional power generation available to reduce blackout risks in the mid-Atlantic.
record.q: Secretary of Energy Chris Wright issued an emergency order to mitigate blackout risks in the mid-Atlantic ahead of a period of elevated demand

record.t: Announced that DOE would not move forward with designating three proposed National Interest Electric Transmission Corridors selected in December 2024.
record.q: will not move forward with designating the three proposed National Interest Electric Transmission Corridors (NIETCs) previously selected in December 2024

record.t: Issued emergency orders to keep two Indiana coal plants operational to ensure continued access to affordable, reliable, and secure electricity in the Midwest.
record.q: Chris Wright issued emergency orders to keep two Indiana coal plants operational to ensure Americans in the Midwest region of the United States have continued access to affordable, reliable, and secure electricity

record.t: Directed the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to initiate rulemaking on a proposed rule that allows customers to file joint, co-located load and generation interconnection requests.
record.q: Secretary Wright’s proposed rule allows customers to file joint, co-located load and generation interconnection requests.

record.t: Testified before the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee on DOE's fiscal year 2026 budget request.

record.q: Secretary of Energy Chris Wright testified today before the U.S. Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on Energy and Water Development on the Department of Energy’s Fiscal Year 2026 budget request.

record.t: Completed DOE's response to comments on the 2024 LNG Export Study, which the department called a step toward returning to regular order on LNG exports.
record.q: today released its Response to Comments on the 2024 LNG Export Study, marking a critical step toward returning to regular order on liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports

record.t: Signed his first Secretarial Order directing DOE to take immediate action to unleash American energy under President Trump's executive orders.
record.q: Secretary of Energy Chris Wright signed his first Secretarial Order today directing the Department of Energy to take immediate action to unleash American Energy in accordance with President Trump’s executive orders.
